title: Parse requirements from the source YAML file
description: The scan workflow shall parse the source requirements YAML and normalize each entry for dashboard use.

title: Extract implementation and test annotations from repository files
description: The scanner shall collect implementation and test annotations from local files so evidence can be linked back to each requirement.

title: Expose summary coverage metrics for the dashboard
description: The API layer shall return total requirements, coverage percentages, orphan counts, and scan timestamps for the dashboard summary.

title: Expose requirement list and detail payloads
description: The API layer shall return requirement list and detail payloads with linked annotations and tasks for traceability review.

title: Expose tasks and orphan traceability datasets
description: The API layer shall return tasks, linked annotations, orphan annotations, and orphan tasks for the dashboard panels.

title: Keep dashboard load time within the mock performance budget
description: The dashboard should render the mock dataset within the assignment performance budget and avoid unnecessary client churn.

title: Sanitize rendered snippets and avoid leaking sensitive paths
description: The dashboard should only render safe code snippets and avoid exposing sensitive repository details in traceability evidence.

title: Export an orphan traceability report
description: The dashboard shall provide an export-ready orphan traceability report for assignment review and follow-up.
